neighbours.label: unclear: the comma or preposition in expository prose that closes a fronted phrase or opens a relation between two things ('With the exception of X,', 'the contrast between', 'an example of'), as against the same content written as plain clauses
fire: Supported by several regional projects over two decades, the program grew steadily.
Of the many styles of folk music in the region, one stands out.
With the notable exception of the opening scene, the film drags.
Revised in 2010, with a new edition in 2018, the handbook is widely used.
The contrast between the two valleys is striking in early spring.
A good example of this is a cooperative owned by its workers.
What is surprising about these findings is their consistency.
As a managed float, the currency moves within a narrow band.
quiet: The program grew steadily over two decades with regional support.
One style of folk music in the region stands out above the rest.
The film drags except for its notable opening scene.
The handbook is widely used and was revised in 2010 and 2018.
The two valleys look very different in early spring.
Workers own the cooperative and share its profits.
The currency moves within a narrow band most of the time.

notes: Card: broad-ish (0.64%), ',' x10 after fronted phrases ('With the possible exception of Boyhood,', 'Of the several varieties of American violence,'), ' of' after 'example', ' between', ' about' after 'remarkable', citation year digit.
